core_obligations: Reduce to the underlying abelian sheaf (proof lines 2061-2066): the cohomology of F on the presheaf of sets K is computed from the underlying abelian sheaf of F, since the topos attached to K only sees the abelian structure.
Apply the companion comparison (proof lines 2066-2070): the companion result identifying the cohomology of a module with that of its underlying abelian sheaf gives the asserted equality.
proof_roadmap: Observe that the cohomology on a presheaf of sets depends only on the underlying abelian sheaf.
Apply the companion comparison between modules and abelian sheaves.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cohomology of a module on a presheaf of sets agrees with the cohomology of its underlying abelian sheaf (statement lines 2052-2059). The proof reduces the first group to the underlying abelian sheaf, since the topos attached to the presheaf of sets sees only the abelian structure (proof lines 2061-2066), and then applies the companion comparison between the cohomology of a module and of its underlying abelian sheaf (proof lines 2066-2070). The non-formal content is the reduction to the abelian case. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one companion result.
